Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.commitmentBody: At BagajPark, the security of our users' personal data is our top priority. Your data is protected using modern encryption standards and processes compliant with GDPR and local regulations.
Privacy.a1: To provide our services, we collect your name, email, phone number, and location data during reservations. Your payment information is processed directly by our licensed payment provider (iyzico) and is not stored on our servers.
Privacy.a2: Collected data is used solely to process your bookings, ensure security, manage communication with shop owners, and fulfill our legal obligations.
Privacy.a3: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, keep your session secure, and analyze usage statistics.
Privacy.a4: Your data is never shared or sold to third parties, except for our business partners essential for service delivery (iyzico, map services) and legal authorities.
Privacy.a5: Personal data is maintained as long as your membership is active or for required legal retention periods. When you close your account, your data is anonymized or deleted.
Privacy.a6: All data transfers are encrypted via SSL/TLS protocols. Our servers undergo regular security scans, and access permissions are strictly monitored.
Privacy.footerBody: For any questions regarding our privacy policy or requests under data protection laws, you can contact us at any time.

FAQ.title: F.A.Q.
FAQ.subtitle: Your questions answered.
FAQ.partnerPitchBody: Turn spare space into revenue—learn how applications and commissions work.
FAQ.a1: Yes. Partner shops follow platform rules; bags are sealed and photographed at drop-off. Protection up to 5,000 TL per bag applies under the conditions described in our Terms — it complements shop operations and is not a standalone retail policy.
FAQ.q2: How do refunds work if I cancel?
FAQ.a2: If you cancel at least 24 hours before check-in, you get a full refund to your card. If between 1 and 24 hours remain before check-in, 50% is refunded to your card. Less than 1 hour before check-in, or after check-in time, there is no card refund — you receive a one-time discount code for the amount paid. If you have not completed payment yet, you can cancel the request anytime at no charge.
FAQ.a3: Pay online with major credit and debit cards through our secure provider (iyzico). Cash is not accepted. Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal can be enabled via Stripe when we activate that gateway — we will announce it on the site.
FAQ.q4: What if the shop is closed or I need help?
FAQ.a4: Contact us via the contact page or WhatsApp. We will help you reschedule, find another nearby storage point, or resolve issues with your booking.
FAQ.q5: What does the insurance line on checkout cover?
FAQ.a5: The insurance fee on checkout contributes to the protection package described in our Terms (up to 5,000 TL per bag when conditions are met). Exact scope, exclusions and claims are set out in the Terms and related notices — read them before you book.
FAQ.a6: You send a request with your dates and bag sizes. The shop reviews and approves. You then complete payment if required and receive a QR code to show at drop-off. This is a request flow — instant confirmation may vary by shop.
FAQ.a7: Yes. We use S, M and XL slots with different daily rates. Choose the size that matches your luggage. Oversized or unusual items may need partner approval — ask support before booking.
FAQ.a8: No. Only online card payments (and future wallet options) are accepted. This keeps a clear payment trail and aligns with platform protection rules.

istanbul.label: Istanbul
istanbul.metaDescription: Secure luggage storage in Istanbul near top sights. Book online and explore the city hands-free.
istanbul.headline: Luggage storage in Istanbul
istanbul.intro: Simplify your travel with our secure luggage storage points in key areas like the Historic Peninsula, Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, and Kadikoy. There is no need to carry heavy suitcases while visiting Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Square, or the Grand Bazaar. Leave your bags sealed with trusted local partners and enjoy the Bosphorus without any weight.

ankara.label: Ankara
ankara.metaDescription: Safe baggage storage in Ankara near museums and the city centre. Simple online booking.
ankara.headline: Luggage storage in Ankara
ankara.intro: Enjoy a comfortable trip to Ankara with storage locations around Kizilay, Tunali Hilmi, Cankaya, and the High-Speed Train Station (ATG). Free yourself of luggage while climbing the steep hills of Ankara Castle or exploring the Museum of Ancient Civilizations. Store your bags during business meetings or museum visits.

izmir.label: Izmir
izmir.metaDescription: Luggage storage in Izmir near Konak, Alsancak and the waterfront. Travel lighter along the coast.
izmir.headline: Luggage storage in Izmir
izmir.intro: Leave your suitcase behind at our secure storage points in Izmir's most vibrant spots like Alsancak, Konak, Kordon, and Karsiyaka. Don't let heavy bags slow you down while exploring the historic Kemeralti Bazaar, the Clock Tower, or walking along the seaside.

antalya.label: Antalya
antalya.metaDescription: Tourist-friendly luggage storage in Antalya near Kaleiçi and beaches. Book in a few taps.
antalya.headline: Luggage storage in Antalya
antalya.intro: End the luggage hassle while wandering the narrow streets of Kaleici (Old Town), visiting the historic Hadrian's Gate, or heading to the beach. Use BagajPark points to make the most of the gap between your check-out time and your flight.

bodrum.label: Bodrum
bodrum.metaDescription: Secure bag storage in Bodrum near the marina and beaches for boats, nights out and day trips.
bodrum.headline: Luggage storage in Bodrum
bodrum.intro: Make your holiday easier with secure luggage storage near Bodrum Castle, the marina, popular beaches, and the main bus station. Leave your suitcases with our partners before joining boat tours or enjoying Bodrum's nightlife.

cappadocia.label: Cappadocia
cappadocia.metaDescription: Luggage storage in Cappadocia for balloon rides and valley hikes around Göreme and Ürgüp.
cappadocia.headline: Luggage storage in Cappadocia
cappadocia.intro: Explore the magical valleys of Cappadocia, Goreme, Urgup, Avanos, and Uchisar without carrying suitcases. Leave your heavy bags at a nearby partner before hiking through fairy chimneys or watching hot air balloons at sunrise.

berlin.label: Berlin
berlin.metaDescription: Secure luggage storage in Berlin near Hauptbahnhof and top sights. Book online in minutes.
berlin.headline: Luggage storage in Berlin
berlin.intro: Find secure storage options near Museum Island, Brandenburg Gate, Alexanderplatz, and Berlin Central Station (Hauptbahnhof). Experience the city's rich history, museums, and nightlife completely hassle-free without dragging heavy suitcases.

paris.label: Paris
paris.metaDescription: Luggage storage in Paris near Gare du Nord, Louvre and central lines.
paris.headline: Luggage storage in Paris
paris.intro: Store your baggage at our verified local partner shops near the Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Gare du Nord, and Gare de l'Est. Banish the luggage drag while dining in Parisian cafes, walking down historic avenues, or cruising down the Seine.

barcelona.label: Barcelona
barcelona.metaDescription: Bag storage in Barcelona near Sagrada Família, beach and city centre.
barcelona.headline: Luggage storage in Barcelona
barcelona.intro: Discover local storage options near La Rambla, Sagrada Familia, Barcelona Cathedral, and the sunny beach zones. Enjoy your walk through the historic Gothic Quarter and along the seaside without dragging suitcases behind you.

rome.label: Rome
rome.metaDescription: Luggage storage in Rome near Termini and the historic centre.
rome.headline: Luggage storage in Rome
rome.intro: Benefit from secure luggage storage near Termini Station, the Colosseum, the Vatican, and the Trevi Fountain. Don't carry suitcases up steep historic stairs or over cobblestones while you explore the ancient city.

amsterdam.metaDescription: Luggage storage in Amsterdam near Centraal and the canal ring.
amsterdam.headline: Luggage storage in Amsterdam
amsterdam.intro: Explore Amsterdam Centraal, Dam Square, and the famous canal rings hands-free. Safely leave your large bags or backpacks with our partners while taking bike tours or visiting museums.
